newsitem.title: MEXICO: Third Mexican septuplet dies of lung failure.
newsitem.headline: Third Mexican septuplet dies of lung failure.

text.p: A third Mexican septuplet died on Sunday of lung failure after surviving 12 days in intensive hospital care, authorities said.
Baby girl Rocio Astrid, named after her 28-year-old mother Maria Rocio Diaz Carrillo, could not be saved because of complications arising from premature birth.

Fernando Rios Montiel, a doctor overseeing the intensive therapy in a Mexico City hospital, said Rocio had struggled to breathe for the past week and died mid-morning. She weighed 23.1 ounces (660 grammes).
Two of Rocio's sisters, the last two babies to be born, died of similar complications on Jan. 24.
Rios Montiel said the four survivors, two boys and two girls, remained in a grave condition because of their undeveloped lungs.
The septuplets' mother had taken fertility medicine after trying unsuccessfully to get pregnant for five years. She gave birth 12 weeks prematurely on Jan. 21.
